preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner or an authorized address
Contract must hold some BNB balance

exploit_hint: As the contract owner or authorized address, call the clearStuckBalance() function with amountPercentage = 100 to drain all BNB from the contract to the marketingFeeReceiver address (which can be changed to attacker's address via setFeeReceivers()). Alternatively, use manualSend() to transfer all BNB to marketingFeeReceiver, or setFeeReceivers() to redirect all fee receivers to attacker-controlled addresses before normal trading operations.
